title: •Uh-oh!
caption: •Uh-oh! (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. During your deploy phase, may ▼ one Clak’dor VII, Neb Dulo, or a musician. While you control Clak’dor VII, your musicians are power and forfeit +2. During your control phase, may retrieve 1 Force for each battleground site you control with a musician. {alter}
lore: Imperial law had no place in the Hutt’s domain.
